rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.15, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-5 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (loss-formulation): gs_ssim_weight 0.0->0.15 (add gs_ssim_weight*(1-SSIM(mu,fbp)) to the per-scene loss; the benchmark is SSIM-scored). Base = iter-4 BEST (warm-start ON, 1024 Gaussians / 130 it -- the run-best config). The SSIM term needs an FBP target, which warm-start provides. PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-1 0.8032 (cold 512G/150it), iter-2 0.8048 (512G/220it, steps FLAT), iter-3 0.8145 (1024G/130it, capacity +0.010), iter-4 0.8539 (warm-start, BEST, +0.039, PSNR 22.50). hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter -- even the best config (warm-start) sits PSNR 22.50 vs 128-view FBP baseline 35.97 (a 13.5 dB gap) -> hr=0. FAILURE MODE: the coarse anisotropic-Gaussian basis cannot reconstruct dense breast soft tissue near the strong sparse-FBP baseline; warm-start gave the biggest lift (it literally seeds from FBP) yet stays far below the FBP floor on the PSNR/RMSE-gated headroom. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): a pure-L2 loss ignores the SSIM the metric rewards; adding an SSIM pull toward FBP structure lifts SSIM above iter-4 0.8539. FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8539 (no lift), the SSIM-loss lever is exhausted. hr expected 0 regardless (matching FBP PSNR 35.97 with a 1024-Gaussian mixture is implausible, and SSIM-weight typically TRADES PSNR DOWN -- the headroom gate is PSNR/RMSE-based, so it cannot move hr off 0). val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). BUDGET: SSIM term = 1 cheap conv/step vs the dominating projection -> same ~990s as iter-4 << 1080 wall. TRAJECTORY: iter-4 0.8539 (warm-start, BEST) -> iter-5 SSIM-loss @0.15 test., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
